# task-dag-runner

> Run Python tasks in a dependency graph with bounded retries, injected sleep, deterministic order and resume from an atomic JSON state file. Python package `trysac-task-dag-runner`, import name `task_dag_runner`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
